instruction: Set the current frame from the video as your desktop wallpaper

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting a video frame as desktop wallpaper. This involves: 1) Taking a snapshot in VLC (Video->Take Snapshot), 2) Opening Settings->Background, 3) Selecting the snapshot file as wallpaper. Evaluator checks if wallpaper path changed from default system wallpaper to a user directory (Pictures/Desktop).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts wallpaper path using gsettings command for GNOME desktop
Metric semantically verifies the instruction requirement: wallpaper changed from system default to user location
Logic correctly checks multiple user directories (Pictures/Desktop/Downloads) where VLC snapshots might be saved
Partial credit (0.5) appropriately handles edge case where wallpaper changed but not to expected user directories
Expected value (default_path: /usr/share/backgrounds/) is correct for Ubuntu system wallpapers
No postconfig needed - wallpaper setting persists and is accessible after agent actions
Complete coverage: single verification requirement (wallpaper changed) is fully checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add explicit check for ~/Pictures/vlc-*.png pattern to match VLC's default snapshot naming convention
Minor: Consider logging warning if wallpaper path is empty/None to help debugging
